title: Chapter 541 - 541 Game Continues; Tug-Of-War!
content:
Chapter 541 - 541 Game Continues; Tug-Of-War!

Chapter 541 - 541 Game Continues; Tug-of-War!

541 Game Continues; Tug-of-War!

Under everyone’s anticipation, the loud and clear voice finally sounded from the broadcast again.

“The second game is folding stars!”

Many people were stunned when they heard this.

Folding stars?

According to the TV show, should it not be a game that involved sugar cookies?

Why did it become folding stars?

How would they know that Lin Fan had specially instructed them to change it?

According to the TV show, one had to lick the sugar cookie with their tongue.

Lin Fan did not want to do that.

The voice on the broadcast did not care about the doubts of the crowd and continued, “Within five minutes, fold as many stars as you can and you can clear the level. For every star that is folded, you’ll receive a reward of 200,000 yuan. The losers will receive a reward of 100,000 yuan.”

As soon as he said this, the entire venue was instantly ignited with enthusiasm.

Everyone completely forgot that the second round did not involve sugar cookies.

200,000 yuan for every star folded!

It was simply a good opportunity to get rich!

Lin Xiaoyao, in particular, shouted excitedly, “Brother, that’s great. It’s folding stars!”

That was because she liked to fold stars when she was free at home. She was very skilled at it.

Lin Fan smiled and nodded.

…

The eyes of the audience outside the stadium turned red.

This was pure jealousy.

“Oh my god! It’s actually folding stars! I can fold one in two minutes… With five minutes… doesn’t that mean I can earn at least 400,000 yuan?!”

“When I was studying, I was bored every day and would fold stars!”

“Why wasn’t I chosen to participate in the game?”

“I regret not signing up!”

…

Amidst the crowd’s excitement and discussion, the masked men in red handed the colorful origami paper to the participants.

The voice on the broadcast said again, “The countdown for the second game, folding stars, begins now!”

10!

9!

8!

…

The numbers on the stage screen kept jumping.

2!

1!

With a soft sound, the players began to fold stars.

Someone once said that time was money.

At this moment, they had a deep understanding of it.

Those who did not know how to fold stars were standing by the side, secretly learning.

Those who knew how to do it would naturally be able to fold it successfully.

It looked simple, but when one really tried to do it, it was not that easy.

Of course, Lin Fan was not one of them.

Lin Fan did not fold the stars. He just watched Lin Xiaoyao’s fingers move quickly. In just a minute, a star was folded.

“200,000!” she muttered.

Then, she hurriedly folded the second star.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but shake his head.

He had never folded stars before, but he had memorized Lin Xiaoyao’s steps by scanning them with his skills.

His speed and skill even surpassed Lin Xiaoyao.

Lin Fan’s first star only took about 40 seconds.

For his second star, the time was shortened to about 30 seconds!

Some people could learn it right away, while others could not.

It seemed like the steps were the same, but in the end, they realized that the stars were actually knotted.

Thus, they had to fold it again.

One mistake, two mistakes…

Five minutes passed.

“Time’s up, stop!”

A loud voice sounded from the broadcast.

Some people did not stop and continued to fold the stars.

The masked men in red raised their guns.

Immediately, the green clothes of the participants who did not fold even one star and those who did not stop folding even after the round ended had a touch of red paint on them.

Eliminated!

Nearly a hundred people were eliminated!

The losers’ faces were filled with sorrow.

The people who passed were filled with joy.

Then…

The phones in everyone’s pockets vibrated.

[Notice from Construction Bank: 200,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 400,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 100,000 yuan was deposited into your account.]

…

When everyone saw the text message, their faces were immediately filled with smiles.

After the losers left, the broadcast sounded again.

“The number of people who passed the second game is 268.

“Next, let me introduce the third game!”

Instantly, everyone became spirited again.

The two consecutive games earned the participants at least 400,000 yuan.

This made them realize the reality of the game.

No one would complain about having too much money. There was still 500 million in cash hanging above their heads!

“The third game is a tug-of-war!

“The two people closest to each other will form a tug-of-war team, and then the competition will be randomly assigned. The winners will clear the stage, and each person will receive a prize of 500,000 yuan! The losers will each receive 200,000 yuan.”

Hearing this, everyone’s hearts began to beat wildly.

In other words, they could at least get another 200,000 yuan!

Once they won, they would get 500,000 yuan!

Everyone hurriedly looked at the person standing beside them.

The strong men and weak women… revealed happy and depressed expressions respectively.

The masked men in red did not pay much attention to them. They took out blue and red number plates and handed them to everyone.

“Brother, can we get through this?” Lin Xiaoyao asked nervously.

After all, she was only a third-year high school student and did not have much strength.

She knew that Lin Fan had solved many difficult math problems, invented many amazing things, and even won the Nobel Prize… He was an amazing professor!

However, the more it was like this, the more it meant that Lin Fan did not have much time to train. He probably was not strong.

How could Lin Fan not understand the meaning behind her words? He smiled and patted her head. “Don’t worry, I can pass.”

One had to know…

He had drunk the Constitution Enhancement Potion several times, and it would not be an exaggeration to say that his current strength was superhuman.

Playing tug-of-war was a piece of cake for him.

Even if the opponent was 20 men, he could still easily win.

When Lin Xiaoyao heard this, her initial nervousness immediately disappeared and was replaced with confidence.

As long as Lin Fan said so, then it would definitely be the case!

The host’s voice rang out again.

“The participants of the tug-of-war will compete according to the blue and red numbers.”

Lin Xiaoyao and Lin Fan had the blue number 33.

After a while, a round-faced man and a tall, thin man walked over with a red number 33.

The number plate was the same, but the color was different!

They were Lin Fan and Lin Xiaoyao’s tug-of-war opponents.

The round-faced man and the lanky man also noticed this.

They chuckled.

“We seem to be quite lucky.”

“Yes, we are.”

As they said this, their eyes flickered.

It was as if they could already see the victory of the tug-of-war round in their hands. They would successfully obtain 500,000 yuan!
